title: Anime Prompt Template (7-Layer Formula)
description: Canonical schema for every template and example in this repository. Layers map to: subject + L1 base system + L2 genre/era + L3 rendering/material + L4 lighting + L5 camera + L6 environment + L7 mood. Layer discipline is enforced: camera words belong in cinematography.camera, never in lighting.

input_variables.description: Named slots usable as {{key}} inside prompt_template.

action_en.description: e.g. looking away from camera, walking through the rain

base_system_en.description: L1. Max 2; mixing japanese + western systems is a known conflict.

genre_era_en.description: L2. e.g. seinen manga style, 1990s anime, xianxia aesthetic.

rendering_en.description: L3 material/rendering. Must not contain words from data/negative-prompts.json conflicts.

lighting_en.description: L4 only. Camera terms are FORBIDDEN here — schema validators should reject 'shot|angle|composition' strings in this field.

mood_en.description: L7. Hard rule from docs/prompt-formula.md: at most TWO mood words, placed last.

composition_notes.description: Chinese notes on layout, e.g. 人物居中偏右，左侧留出小巷纵深与雨幕。Not injected into prompts.

prompt_template.description: Assembled prompt with optional {{variables}}. Layer order must follow subject → style(L1..L3) → lighting → camera → environment → mood.

fixed_prompt.description: Optional fully-assembled variant with no variables, ready to copy-paste.

negative_prompt.description: Canonical negative list. Adapters translate it per platform (see docs/model-guides.md): SDXL keeps it as-is; Midjourney maps to --no; GPT-Image-2 rewrites into 'avoid ...' natural language instructions because it has NO negative-prompt field.

platforms.description: Tested/target platforms. midjourney-niji is the DEFAULT for anime styles.

conflicts.description: Word pairs that must not co-occur in this template, referencing docs/style-conflicts.md.
